prior_evidence: Pan-cancer studies linked HLA-I zygosity/HED to ICI outcomes; Lee and SNiP-RCC evaluated HLA diversity in RCC.
present_reanalysis: Uses published HLA calls to reconstruct the Lee locus-specific observation and maps concordant and null RCC contexts.
what_the_present_work_does_not_establish: A new general HLA diversity biomarker

prior_evidence: RCC studies report variable or weak associations between mutation measures and ICI outcomes.
present_reanalysis: Miao shows an independent mutation-only adverse PFS association; multiple other RCC datasets are null under nonidentical definitions.
what_the_present_work_does_not_establish: A uniform mutation-burden effect across RCC treatments

prior_evidence: The original Lee study reported HED associations and an adverse but nonsignificant zygosity trend.
present_reanalysis: Shows the three highlighted cases are above the official mutation-count median with early PFS events but that the 2 x 2 design has an empty cell.
what_the_present_work_does_not_establish: A separable mutation-by-HLA-A interaction or a clinical classifier

prior_evidence: Pan-cancer MSK outcome data support study of TMB and HLA constructs.
present_reanalysis: Finds an FDR-retained post hoc any-HLA-homozygosity association within median-high-TMB ccRCC but no interaction surviving the stated correction family.
what_the_present_work_does_not_establish: Direct replication of the Lee HLA-A/PFS state or proof of effect modification

prior_evidence: Allele-specific anchor preferences are established HLA biology.
present_reanalysis: Replaces a selected 29-event subset with the complete archived 63-event retained universe and finds terminal-class-dependent predicted allocation.
what_the_present_work_does_not_establish: Natural presentation of the discovery mutant peptides or T-cell recognition

prior_evidence: PXD017149 provides RCC HLA-I ligandome sequences.
present_reanalysis: Shows basic termini occur among naturally presented RCC ligands as background context.
